experience.text: At Unique Design, I worked on both the design and development of websites. I created designs in Figma and turned them into custom WordPress themes using PHP and ACF. One of my main projects was Restaurant GEM, where I was responsible for the entire design and most of the development.

My work at Bewise was a mix of building new websites and maintaining existing ones. I worked mainly with WordPress and Elementor, tested websites, fixed issues and made updates. I also designed some websites, joined client meetings and spoke directly with clients about their requests.
During my internship at Bewise Solutions, I helped with IT support for SOVOT. I answered support questions, helped users with technical issues and worked with colleagues to find solutions.

about.text: I'm a frontend developer based in Noord-Brabant, and I enjoy UI design just as much as coding. I like working out how something should look and feel, then bringing it to life in the browser. I've also worked with backend development, databases and APIs, so I enjoy figuring out what happens behind the scenes too. Outside of school and internships, I like building my own ideas and trying out new things.

what.title: Design
what.text: I like figuring out the layout, typography and little details that make an interface feel right.

what.title: Build
what.text: Frontend is my favorite part, but I've also built features that work with APIs, databases and backend logic.

what.title: Automate
what.text: I've also worked with tools like n8n and GoHighLevel to connect systems and automate repetitive tasks.
